descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S11 Day and retention boundaries: yesterday's Complete, yesterday's In Today, and the 12 h / 18 h / 36 h clocks against the buckets

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 With patients in a mix of pending / in-progress / complete states, the dashboard counts (Total, Pending, In Progress, Complete) match the real patient-list state, in Hospital and in Nursing Home (UAT TC-20; TFA-92598 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T4 'In Today' attendance is kept per day by the server clock, so the dashboard counts follow each server day's attendance. A device with a wrong clock or another time zone shows the same counts (TFA-92587 AC 6; UAT 3.8)
  • U5 Nursing Home counts are based on the residents marked 'In Today'. Marking a resident adds them to the counts. Un-marking removes them from today's counts without deleting them from All Residents (UAT TC-09; TFA-92598 AC 4; TFA-92587 AC 6; TFA-92587 AC 2)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Hospital: (a) a complete patient with a note 17 h old and another with a note 19 h old; (b) a pre-rounded-only patient (no encounter, no note) at pre-round age 11 h and at 13 h, and one pre-rounded at 05:00 UTC read at 18:00 UTC and again after the server-day change; …

When Advance the server clock (or back-date the records) to each age, then open both dashboards and each patient's chart

Then Each patient's bucket matches what the chart then shows. A chart whose pre-round text or dictation was cleared by the clock is not counted as work in progress unless Q10 says so. The 19 h note patient's bucket is recorded and judged after Q4. The resident's In Today follows today's attendance (TFA-92587 AC 6, server time). …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 windows (Hospital pre-round 12 h, encounter 18 h, note 18 h, open tasks 36 h; Nursing Home pre-round 12 h), TFA-92587 AC 6 'persists correctly per day (server time) and drives the dashboard counts', UAT 3.8. Oracle per row: the bucket matches what the chart then shows; where the chart is empty but the status is not, record it and judge after Q10; …

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-20.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela; the Allure status was changed by the triage from failed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92598 in progress; TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress

A Hospital patient pre-rounded early in the morning (before 09:00 in Tokyo) drops back to Pending on the dashboard when the server's UTC day changes, even though the pre-round text is still on the chart.

Evidence: allure-results/8ed8fb19…: 8/10 judged cells pass. Both fails are gated (U1: TFA-92598 in progress): (b) a pre-round 11 h old goes back to Pending at the server's UTC midnight while its text is still on the chart; (d) an open task 37 h old is still counted (no Hospital open-task window, TFA-94699, TC-22 Q10). One cell is not run (needs a rerun after 13:00 UTC). What counts as 'today' is the open question TC-20 Q4.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: manual.

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S11

Day and retention boundaries: yesterday's Complete, yesterday's In Today, and the 12 h / 18 h / 36 h clocks against the buckets

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa); TFA-92598 Rounding Dashboard (in progress)

New local lane manual: status failed in manual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: yes): api spec. Fresh account, Hospital rows: complete with note 17 h / 19 h; pre-rounded-only at 11 h / 13 h; pre-rounded at 05:00 UTC today read now and one pre-rounded on the previous server day; seen-no-note at encounter age 17/19/36 h; open task 35/37 h after last processing. NH: pre-round 11 h / 13 h; resident In Today and Complete on the previous server day. applyLifecycle; read rounding:listCounts / snf:listCounts and each row; compare bucket with what the chart then holds. — Deterministic server reads; Q4/Q10 cells recorded.

Detail:

8/10 judged cells pass, 5 recorded, 1 NOT RUN. Fail: (b) pre-round 11 h: In Progress and the pre-round text is on the chart [U1; gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress] | (d) open task 37 h after last processing: the row's pending task count drops it [U1; gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress]. Not run: (b) pre-rounded 05:00 UTC read at 18:00 UTC the same server day (it is 06:59 UTC now: a stamp 13 h back crosses the server's midnight; rerun after 13:00 UTC (22:00 JST)). Recorded: (a) note 19 h: bucket after the note left the chart (Q4) = {"status":"pending","bucket":"Pending","preRound":"","encounter":"","note":"","openTasks":0} | (b) pre-round 13 h: text cleared by the clock; bucket (Q10: counted as work in progress?) = {"status":"pending","bucket":"Pending","preRound":"","encounter":"","note":"","openTasks":0} | (c) seen, encounter 19 h: encounter left the working tab; bucket (Q10) = {"status":"seen","bucket":"In Progress","preRound":"","encounter":"","note":"","openTasks":0} | (c) seen, encounter 36 h: encounter left the working tab; bucket (Q10) = {"status":"seen","bucket":"In Progress","preRound":"","encounter":"","note":"","openTasks":0} | (f) NH resident marked In Today and completed on the previous server day: In Today and its bucket this morning (Q3 / Q4) = {"status":"pending","bucket":"Pending","preRound":"","encounter":"","note":"","openTasks":0,"inTodaysSession":true,"snfCounts":{"done":0,"re.

Product issue: Gated (U1: TFA-92598 in progress); whose day counts is Q9. A Hospital patient pre-rounded 11 h ago (19:xx UTC, 04:xx Tokyo) and read at 06:xx UTC has gone back to Pending. Pending means 'not yet prepped', yet the pre-round text is still on the chart. The server-day rule resets the badge at the server's UTC midnight, not at the physician's day or the 12 h window. In Tokyo a pre-round done before 09:00 flips at 09:00. In New York every pre-round still showing at 20:00 that evening flips then. Also known: an open task 37 h after the last processing is still counted on the row (no Hospital open-task window on main, TFA-94699).

During the run (runNote): Re-run 15:59 JST (06:59 UTC) on the current spec (Hospital bucket cells tagged U1): same observations as the 05:52 UTC run, no relabelling. The '05:00 UTC read at 18:00 UTC the same server day' cell can only run after 13:00 UTC (22:00 JST) and is not run.

Evidence: 5 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Aging the records to 11/13/17/19/35/37 h and moving the server day need the aging helper and a server-clock control through the local stack's admin key; dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot be moved, so this stays on the local stack (when the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
